title: Weird Matter Lab
domain: Explain counterintuitive material responses through safe interactive observation.
scenario: Enter the lab, choose a supported specimen, apply its on-screen stimulus, and explain the visible response.
steps: Press Enter the Lab and choose a supported specimen.
Use the specimen's on-screen control to apply a stimulus and observe immediate feedback.
Reach the experiment result, explain the response, and reset or select another specimen.
evidence: A completed safe specimen interaction with an observation, explanation, and reachable reset path.
